matchers/iac/terraform/matcher.yaml

id: terraform
role: tool
classification: [iac]
description: Terraform's boxed `Error:` and the `on main.tf line 12` it points at.
pattern: '^\s*│\s*Error: |on .+\.tf line \d+'
before: 1
after: 12
